name: phosphoinositide-3-kinase regulatory subunit 3

function.text: PIK3R3 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase regulatory subunit gamma. Annotated molecular activities include 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase activity and 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase regulator activity. It participates in phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and immune response.
